title: Kiritani Haruka — Connect Even The Heart〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One week before the solo show

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four... Five, six, seven, eight...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should be enough stretching.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I still can't believe how we're already at this point. I mean, our solo show's just a week away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess it's only natural since it's her very first one...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It felt like I was stepping back in time when I told the others in SEKAI about our own experiences...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe I should take this opportunity to go back to my roots and watch an ASRUN show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, this show...
The dance routine for one of the songs was so difficult.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember how we couldn't get in sync for the chorus, the most important part... And before we knew it, the show had crept up on us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And yet, we still managed to pull it off. We all high-fived after returning backstage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? This is... Oh, that's right! The set list for this show had a lot of dance routines with really fun tempos!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I was so exhausted by the time we had to greet everyone that my feet were shaking. I remember being so worried that my voice would do the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned the hard way that my strength and stamina still needed work, which is why I began running every day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already this late...
All this nostalgia... I couldn't help but keep watching...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I should call it a night and... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“HONEY”...?
As in when “Maidenly Honey Mustard” was released...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This tour was a lot of fun too.
Hehe. Okay, I'll watch this and then call it a night...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this was the tour when we decided to start using that little trolley.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I ended up having so much fun that I sort of ended up leaning out of it a little too much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the staff scolded me afterwards for doing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: <Let's make the best of our time together and make this a moment to remember.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can only see this person's back because of where the camera is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She mentioned a few times that she'd gone to a lot of ASRUN's shows and meet and greets...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you've given me so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you gave me my dream of becoming an idol!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She was next to me this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I only remember having fun while riding this trolley and getting scolded afterwards... I'd completely forgotten to look at my fans' faces...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If only I did this one time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get to sing while standing right next to each other.
